content.text:
cd /workspace && git commit -m "add smoke test mode with 3-per-organizer limit for fast ingestion verification
- Added --mode=smoke CLI flag for quick verification
- MAX 3 events per organizer/venue (grouping by venue_id → venue_name → organizer → source)
- MAX 25 events per source as safeguard
- Separate 'ingestion_smoke' queue for isolation
- Full logging: fetched/after-limit/queued/normalized/upserted per source
- Drop-off analysis shows where data is lost in pipeline
- All sources run: ticketmaster, kulturhuset, debaser, kulturhuset-barn-ung, eventbrite, billetto
- Normalizer runs exactly as normal (no shortcuts)
- Full ingestion unchanged - smoke test is additive
Test result: 6/6 sources run, 29 events queued, 14 normalized/upserted
Körningstid: ~30 sekunder (vs 5+ minuter för full ingestion)"
